detail: Planner is scanning GitHub for the next review candidates. Candidate counts and shard details will be posted after planning completes.

last_close_apply_health.summary: 187 examined; 51/600 action records; 9 closed, 9 comments synced, 33 skipped; cursor at #110695.

next_actions.label: Inspect skip
next_actions.summary: Apply reported an unmapped skip bucket.
next_actions.next_step: Inspect the workflow run and add a deterministic mapping if this repeats.

next_actions.label: Refresh review
next_actions.summary: The item changed after the review that proposed closing it.
next_actions.next_step: Queue a fresh ClawSweeper review before any close retry.

next_actions.label: Live close guard
next_actions.summary: Current GitHub state no longer satisfies the low-signal close policy.
next_actions.next_step: Leave the item open until a later review or live-state change makes it eligible.

next_actions.label: Runtime budget
next_actions.summary: The apply lane stopped because it reached its bounded runtime.
next_actions.next_step: Let the next scheduled run continue; tune runtime or batch size if this repeats.

next_actions.label: Refresh review state
next_actions.summary: The durable review comment is newer than the local review report.
next_actions.next_step: Queue a fresh review instead of overwriting the newer durable comment.

next_actions.label: Maintainer decision
next_actions.summary: A protected label or policy exemption blocks automated pruning.
next_actions.next_step: Confirm the policy should remain, or close manually if it should not.

next_actions.label: Stable skip
next_actions.summary: The source and canonical items have the same author, so automated duplicate close is intentionally conservative.
next_actions.next_step: Leave as a stable skip unless maintainers change the same-author close policy.

cycle.label: 506 currently actionable close candidates (7 confirmed proposals, 162 guarded retries, 337/855 promotion probes admitted; 2 require proof; 596 cooldown-eligible backlog (418 promotions); 1 inconsistent or stale record excluded) at 187 records per latest cursor advance: about 3 windows; scheduled cadence alone would take roughly 45 min at 15-minute intervals, while successful windows can continue sooner.
